title: OpenTrix application manifest (format v1)
description: Describes one OpenTrix application as apps/<app-id>/app.json. Only the outer frame is defined here; each entity is a JSON Schema 2020-12 document and the workflow is a BPMN 2.0 file referenced by path.

id.description: Application identifier: lowercase letters, digits and hyphens, starting with a letter.

version.description: Application version, a Semantic Versioning 2.0.0 string. The pattern is the official regular expression published at https://semver.org (section 'Is there a suggested regular expression (RegEx) to check a SemVer string?').

license.description: SPDX License Identifier of the application (https://spdx.org/licenses/). Checked by pattern only; membership in the SPDX License List is not verified.

name.description: Display name per language. The key is a BCP 47 language tag; 'en' is required.

description.description: Description per language. The key is a BCP 47 language tag; 'en' is required.

entities.description: Data entities of the application. The key is the entity name; the value is a JSON Schema 2020-12 document describing one record.

roles.description: Roles of the application. The key is the role name.

workflow.description: Workflow of the application. States and transitions are defined in the BPMN 2.0 file (ISO/IEC 19510:2013), not in this manifest.

bpmn.description: Relative path to the .bpmn file, resolved against the directory that contains the manifest.

processKey.description: The id attribute of the BPMN process element to run.
